axis: studio = (-x, z, y) of blender; Blender front -Y = Studio front -Z
units: studs; the model is at final size, import 1:1 and do not scale
sides: L/R are the fox's own left/right; its left is Blender +X = Studio -X
origin: all positions are relative to the model origin = the ground point under the body pivot (Blender world origin)
texture_note: one shared atlas; every MeshPart uses the same TextureID (Rare: one painted charm, no Neon, no glow)
rest_rotation: every part has identity rotation relative to the model at rest
rig: one Motor6D per part: Part0 = joint_parent, Part1 = the part, C0/C1 placed at the part's pivot

Fox_Body.suggested_motion: root part: bob up/down in Studio Y and a small roll about Studio Z while running; crouch before a pounce

Fox_Head.suggested_motion: nod = pitch about Studio X, tilt = roll about Studio Z, look = yaw about Studio Y, all through the neck joint

Fox_EarL.pivot_is: ear root on the skull (flop pivot)
Fox_EarL.suggested_motion: flick / flop = rotate about Studio Z (front-back axis) through the ear root; child of the head

Fox_EarR.pivot_is: ear root on the skull (flop pivot)
Fox_EarR.suggested_motion: flick / flop = rotate about Studio Z (front-back axis) through the ear root; child of the head

Fox_LegFL.suggested_motion: trot / pounce reach = swing about Studio X (side-to-side axis) through the shoulder

Fox_LegFR.suggested_motion: trot / pounce reach = swing about Studio X (side-to-side axis) through the shoulder

Fox_LegBL.suggested_motion: trot / pounce push = swing about Studio X (side-to-side axis) through the hip

Fox_LegBR.suggested_motion: trot / pounce push = swing about Studio X (side-to-side axis) through the hip

Fox_Tail.pivot_is: tail root (wag = turn about the vertical axis)
Fox_Tail.suggested_motion: wag / sweep = yaw about Studio Y through the tail root (lift = pitch about Studio X)

Fox_Scarf.suggested_motion: flutter = swing about Studio X (and a little about Studio Z) through the knot; lags the body
